{%- assign papers = site.papers | sort: "order" -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }} Open anthology by S. Lavi (github.com/idl3o), licensed CC BY 4.0. {{ papers | size }} documents, each a working draft carrying its own version; the version is the unit the corpus cites by.

Every document is a page on this site and a Markdown file under `_papers/` in the repository (https://github.com/{{ site.repository }}). Documents are grouped here by track. Within a track the `order` field is the sequence in which things were written, not the order they depend on each other. Mathematics is set in Unicode. Each technical paper closes with a mandatory "What Is Declined" section naming the readings it refuses, numbered "Open Problems", and the `code/` module that reproduces its measurements where it has any.

## Machine-readable
- [papers.json]({{ '/papers.json' | absolute_url }}): every document's front matter as JSON, sorted by order.
- [Atom feed]({{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}): the papers collection, newest first by date.
- [Sitemap]({{ '/sitemap.xml' | absolute_url }}).
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/{{ site.repository }}/blob/main/CITATION.cff): how to cite the collection.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/{{ site.repository }}/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): per-document versions and what moved.
- [Source](https://github.com/{{ site.repository }}): `_papers/` (current versions), `_archive/` (superseded versions), `code/` (instruments), `lean/` (machine-checked proofs).
